messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Possibility of DataTables Column Selection
parts: The documentation of datatable in DT has a selection parameter, which is for row selection. Is it possible to disable column sorting when the column name is clicked and allow column selection to happen instead, but keeping the small triangles next to the column name for sorting purposes ? The use case I imagine is allowing the user to select multiple rows (samples) and multiple columns (features), then click a button to generate a PCA plot pop-up, using only data that is contained in the user-selected rows and columns.
